full_judgment: 7. Mr. Mahbubur Rahman the learned Advocate, appearing on behalf of the appellant submits that the judgment of the lower appellate Court Is not a judgment of proper reversal. In view of the fact that the learned lower appellate Court did not controvert the finding and decision of the trial Court to the effect that defendants were recognised as tenants by the Government, that defendants pale rent to the Government and received dakhilas and the Rent-roll was also prepared by the Government in their names. He, therefore, submits that defendants are entitled to get the disputed lard. The learned Advocate submits that Judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court are liable to be set aside.
